articles.title: Cambridge City Council votes to temporarily restore controversial ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology
articles.description:
At the council meeting, more than a dozen residents and advocates spoke against restoring ShotSpotter, while only a handful argued the system should be reinstalled. 

The post Cambridge City Council votes to temporarily restore controversial ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Cambridge City Council voted to temporarily restore ShotSpotter technology on August 3, 2026.
Over a dozen residents opposed the restoration, citing concerns about its effectiveness.
The decision may affect community trust and police-community relations in Cambridge.

articles.title: ‘Playbook of destruction’: Markey, Moulton meet for combative second debate ahead of Sept. primary
articles.description:
Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton each cast themselves as progressives willing to fight the Trump administration while attacking their opponent's character.

The post ‘Playbook of destruction’: Markey, Moulton meet for combative second debate ahead of Sept. primary appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton debated on August 3, 2026, ahead of the September primary.
Both candidates positioned themselves as progressives opposing the Trump administration's policies.
The debate intensified local political engagement among Boston residents ahead of the upcoming election.
